rows.grounds: compound evam-ādi-tala in locative singular, indicating a floor or platform of this kind
compound antaraprastara-anvita, describing the constructed object as provided with intermediate layers or courses

items.question: What structural feature must be included when constructing a floor of this described kind?
premises: The construction takes place on a floor of the kind previously described.
The prescribed action is that one should make or arrange the structure.
The resulting structure must be furnished with intermediate courses.
items.inference: Therefore, a floor of this type should be constructed so as to include intermediate courses.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of antaraprastara in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: On a floor of this kind, one should construct it furnished with intermediate courses.
